subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — quick intro + tech fit

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:03:00-04:00
Subject: Demo request — Acme Corp

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — I signed up through the site and booked a demo for next week (June 30 at 10:00 AM ET). We're evaluating inference platforms for a search/retrieval product and I'd like to focus on latency/cost tradeoffs and private deployment options.

A few quick details about us: Acme's search traffic is ~150k queries/day with ~300 token average contexts. We host on AWS and are sensitive to latency spikes.

Can you send an agenda or any pre-read so I can loop in our infra lead?

Thanks,
Jordan

- 10m demo: latency/cost controls, batching, and private deployment options
